problem.title: Find the Largest Perfect Binary Search Tree Subtree
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree, determine the size of the largest subtree that is both a Binary Search Tree and a perfect binary tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the size of the largest qualifying subtree.
